question: Why is all everywhere from full one-nature?
premises: From full one-nature all is everywhere too.
Otherwise, division being inapplicable, fullness would not be full.
inference: One-natured fullness entails all-everywhere, since division would unfull it.
uncertainties: The too-scope across all and everywhere.
plain_english: Therein, from being of full one nature, all is everywhere too — for otherwise, division being inapplicable, fullness would not be full.
